name: Figura Performance
description: Decides how many Figura avatars are worth showing at once. Figura draws every avatar around you in full, however far away that player is and whether or not they are on screen, and the cost is not only the model: for each of them it also edits the vanilla player model, walks its own layers and draws a custom nameplate. This mod hides the ones you are not looking at, the ones past a distance and the ones over a limit, so a crowd stops eating your frame rate. Hidden avatars cost nothing at all, the same as Figura's panic button, only per player instead of all at once. Comes with an overlay naming the avatars that cost the most, in milliseconds and frames.
